test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter and symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) E # R & H & @ J & M N # B & V & & D # P @ W % & Q & A % & # E & (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be third from the left?
solution:
**Given:**

 letter and symbol series:

(Left) E # R & H & @ J & M N # B & V & & D # P @ W % & Q & A % & # E & (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88c28e65b429a30bf93485ddb707d141d33044bff526279f647d4451069cf4e5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e05f0faafca8df98fe7239c61751da03d7e05bb0caf1e53511a39249e5ef723d.png] 

 Then, third from the left is H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90b067d73e940c2e7fe54bd737f605990705c3ec0c0bff26f1c3d83627821597.png] 

The correct answer is** 'H'**.
